title: HDS Requirement
description: A single mapped requirement in an HDS scope, expressed across the three-layer model: the Pryv platform layer (inherited, referenced), the HDS layer (authored), and the implementer layer (per-persona obligations).

text.description: Paraphrased requirement text. Do NOT redistribute copyrighted standards verbatim.

pryv_ref.description: ref of the inherited platform-layer row in the layered_on_pryv scope (vendor/pryv). Optional — set when Pryv's matrix covers this requirement.

implementer.description: What's still on the plate of whoever builds on HDS, one entry per persona.

hdsLayer.description: What HDS-as-operator + the HDS app stack adds on top of the platform layer.

effort_saved.description: How much of the requirement HDS carries for the implementer.

overview.description: 2-3 sentence position. Audience: auditor / compliance officer.

regions.description: Data-residency regions where this HDS claim holds. Omit if region-independent.

planned.description: Queued work whose delivery would change this row's claim, each entry backed by evidence it is actually coming (a compliance-internal document moving through review, a public tracking issue, or a vendored upstream proposal). Rendered as one chip per entry alongside the coverage badge; scope pages filter on it. THIS REPO IS PUBLIC: reference only internal document CODES, public URLs, or vendored paths — never private workspace paths or plan numbers.

kind.description: feature = HDS app/infra capability queued for delivery; doc = a compliance-internal document drafted and moving through review/approval (name its code in internal_doc); procedure = an operational procedure being stood up (first verified execution pending); platform = an upstream platform feature queued by the vendor whose shipping AND HDS-side deploy+verify would change this row's claim (authored uplink — impact rated from the HDS row's perspective, not the vendor's; anchor it with upstream_proposal).

summary.description: One-line description of what's queued (rendered in the chip tooltip).

impact.description: How much this row's claim shifts when delivered. high = coverage tier likely changes; medium = effort/facilitation upgrade; low = wording / evidence refinement.

internal_doc.description: CODE of the compliance-internal document evidencing the pending delivery (e.g. 'gdpr/registers/records-of-processing'), same convention as evidence.internal_docs[]. The code is public; the content is released only on request.

tracking_url.description: PUBLIC tracker only (GitHub issue / public project card). Never a private workspace path.

upstream_proposal.description: Path to the vendored upstream proposal this chip is gated on (e.g. 'vendor/pryv/proposals/e2e-encryption.md'). The file must exist in the snapshot — validate.js fails otherwise, so every sync:pryv automatically flags uplinked chips whose upstream item shipped or was dropped.

eta.description: Optional coarse, honest target (e.g. '2026-Q4'). Omit rather than guess.

evidence.description: Proof for the HDS-layer claim. THIS REPO IS PUBLIC: cite only public material or internal document CODES (never operational/infra detail). implemented/configurable require at least one of docs[], internal_docs[] or tests[].

tests.description: Public (open-source) test codes only, e.g. from open-pryv.io.

docs.description: PUBLIC documentation only — public URLs or paths in public repos (e.g. dev-site, this repo's docs/).

internal_docs.description: CODES of documents held privately in compliance-internal (e.g. 'hipaa/policies/security-management-process'). The code is public; the content is released only on request under NDA / signed BAA / audit engagement.

persona.description: Who this obligation applies to. HIPAA: covered-entity/business-associate/individual. GDPR & Swiss nLPD: controller/processor/data-subject. SOC 2: service-organization/user-entity/subservice-organization. 'partner' = the generic organisation building on HDS.

overview.description: What this persona must still do themselves.

templates.description: ids of agreement templates (templates/<id>) this persona must sign for this row.
